title: Pip Pressed Undo on Everything
altTitles: He Found an UNDO Button (Big Mistake)
Never Give Pip an Undo Remote
description: Pip found a remote with one button: UNDO. Spills, trips, sneezes, sunsets... then Bolt. #stickfigure #animation #shorts
topic: INK-05 F1 escalation comedy (Pip lead): an undo remote escalates small, medium, big, too big; lore: the arrow glows Nib-gold

snippets.STYLE: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading.
snippets.LOCK: Faces are two glowing eye-dots only: no mouth, no nose, no teeth, no brows, no smile. Each figure is one separate distinct body that never merges or fuses with another figure or object. Arms end in simple rounded tips with at most three rounded nubs, never realistic human hands. Every figure keeps its signature accessories in every frame. Consistent glossy 3D render throughout, never flat 2D. Every surface is blank and unmarked, with no readable text or letters; any sign shows a simple icon only.
snippets.BOLT: BOLT: an average-height black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, electric cyan (#22D3EE) glowing eyes and rim light, a long flowing cyan scarf that trails light when moving
snippets.PIP: PIP: a short, small black ink stick figure (half BOLT's height) with a round glossy head, amber (#FFB020) glowing eyes and rim light, oversized brass aviator goggles on the forehead, a boxy amber backpack with antennae
snippets.NOVA: NOVA: a tall slender black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, magenta (#FF3DA5) glowing eyes and rim light, a single curved topknot line rising from the head, carrying a glowing magenta bo staff
snippets.BRICK: BRICK: a large black ink stick figure with thick heavy limbs (three times normal thickness) and a round glossy head, lime green (#7CFF4F) glowing eyes and rim light, a lime visor band across the eyes
snippets.NEG: Avoid: text, letters, numbers, readable signs, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, eyebrows, smiles, human faces, skin, hair, realistic human hands, five-finger hands, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fused or merged bodies, flat 2D cartoon look, blood, gore, flat or empty backgrounds.
snippets.KF: stick figure, NOT a human, no face, no skin, no clothing except listed accessory. Deep focus, sharp to the frame edges, full-frame image with no borders or letterbox bands. Vertical 9:16 frame.
snippets.TINK: a single glossy ink drip falling and landing, followed by one bright crisp glass tink, clean and close
snippets.REMOTE: THE REMOTE: a tiny amber plastic remote control the size of Pip's palm, with a single round button bearing an embossed curved-arrow icon that glows warm Nib-gold (#FFC940); blank, no letters or numbers.
snippets.DESK: a huge sunlit oak writing desk seen at tiny-hero scale: real wood grain, a real glass ink jar, loose cream paper sheets, pencils and wooden toy blocks towering over the figures, soft window light with floating dust motes
snippets.ROOM: quiet sunlit study room tone, a softly ticking wall clock and faint birdsong through a window, seamless
snippets.REWIND: a VHS tape rewinding: fast chattering reverse warble with a rising whirr
snippets.REV_NOTE: Generated forward; the clip is played time-reversed in the edit, so every motion must be one clean, readable action.

qc: INK-05: Reverse beats (S2, S3, S4, S7, S9, S12, S14, S19) are generated forward and reversed by the worker: the keyframe is the FORWARD first frame, so it becomes the reversed LAST frame; check each reversed clip reads as a rewind and that Pip stays still in it (no moonwalk limb tangles). Remote: tiny, amber, one gold curved-arrow button, blank, never bigger than Pip's head; the gold matches the Nib (#FFC940). Drift: Pip keeps goggles + backpack in every shot; Bolt's scarf stays on (also in the S15 outline and the S17 cake return); Nova keeps staff + topknot; Brick keeps lime visor + thick limbs. S8/S9 sneeze: zero mouths or noses, the sneeze is a whole-body jolt. S14 sky: the sun stays in the sky, real rooftops, no flat gradient. S15 is CS4 with refs [1 Bolt, 2 Pip] (subset, tokens renumbered): check 9:16, outline stays see-through cyan, not a second Bolt. S16 flicker must not flatten into 2D. Labels only top (UNDO #n counter) or lower-third, never over faces. Audio: room-tone bed under every section plus music; drip-tink at 0, S10 and S19. Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory / size swap = re-roll; 3rd limb or fused/merged body ≥3 frames = re-roll; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows, smile, skin or human face even 1 frame = reject; realistic human hands or more than three nubs = re-roll; flat/white/empty bg, 2D look, lost rim light or blood = re-roll; any legible or pseudo-glyph text in a plate = mask or re-roll (all real text is Remotion labels). Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
